name: unused-css-vue
description:
Unused CSS Vue is a Visual Studio Code extension that enhances your Vue single-file components (.vue files) by visually differentiating CSS class declarations. The extension automatically scans the <style> sections in your Vue files and decorates the CSS class selectors—changing their text color to a darker shade—to help you easily spot and review them.

Key Features:

- Automatic Detection: Monitors your workspace for changes in .vue files and identifies CSS class declarations within <style> blocks.
- Visual Enhancement: Applies a darker color to the CSS class declarations for improved readability.
- Dynamic Updates: Continuously updates decorations as you edit Vue components.
- Seamless Integration: Integrates effortlessly into your VS Code environment to improve CSS debugging and styling workflow.

With Vue CSS Colorizer, managing and maintaining your component styles becomes more intuitive and visually guided.
